name: perspective-writer
description: Authentic-voice writing marketplace: letters, emails, autobiographies, and formal documents written by simulating the writer's voice and the recipient's context. Tarski T-Schema referent discipline (every sentence points to something concrete and verifiable), role calibration per expertise domain, and a feedback-learning loop that persists style rules across sessions.

plugins.name: perspective-writer
plugins.description: Write letters, emails, autobiographies, and formal documents by simulating the writer's authentic voice. Uses Tarski's T-Schema to ensure every sentence has a concrete referent, and a 6-phase process (understand writer, understand recipient, simulate, write, anti-pattern check, iterate) to produce writing that sounds like a real person, not AI.
